configuration.label: Inner-crossfitted restrained affine calibration before fixed spline fusion
configuration.formula: 3-fold inner OOF corrected Kumo on6k; fit a,b by meanBCE(a+b*logit(p_inner))+.02/2*(a^2+(b-1)^2), a in[-.5,.5], b in[.5,1.5]; pK=sigmoid(z25+.5*(a+(b-1)*z25)); final=.75*pK+.25*spline77
configuration.rationale: V178 improves4/5folds but loses4 defaults at top20%; alignment across expert/fold scores may affect pooled ranking. V163 only class-prior shift was exactly baseline. This tests empirical crossfitted slope+intercept, not theoretical prior correction. Positive monotone calibration alone cannot improve standalone within-fold KS; any change must arise from fusion or fold alignment.

configuration.label: Delete-one-third bagging of V25 correction heads
configuration.formula: Split6k correction into3 disjoint query blocks; train3 independent V25 heads on complementary4k rows; pK=mean_j sigmoid(logit(Kumo)+.5*X_j*beta_j); final=.75*pK+.25*spline77
configuration.rationale: V167 train/heldout head KS gap .016101 vsV25 .011108. Test correction-estimation variance reduction rather than adding Kumo features, which decreased KS in V169:176. Distinct from V173 context bagging;50k Kumo context stays unchanged.

configuration.label: Baseline-orthogonalized spectral innovation residual
configuration.formula: B=(X25^T*X25/n+.01I)^(-1)*X25^T*S9/n; R=S9-X25*B; fit gamma by BCE(z25+R*gamma)+.03/2||gamma||^2+.2/2 mean((R*gamma)^2); eta=z25+.25*R*gamma; final=.75*sigmoid(eta)+.25*spline77
configuration.rationale: V167 spectral addition has strongest KS .530795 but higher head gap; V179 group ridge andV180 reliability residual did not improve KS. This tests only spectral basis innovation after ridge projection on existing V25 design, including missingness, rather than refitting redundant coefficients. All projections use6k correction only.

configuration.label: Inner-OOF hierarchical employment and history calibration
configuration.formula: On inner OOF z fit additive b0+b_employment+b_history with meanBCE(z+delta)+.02/2*b0^2+.04/2*sum(b_group^2); history=zero/1_to3/over3/missing allocation. eta=z25+.5*clip(delta,-.25,.25); final=.75*sigmoid(eta)+.25*spline77; unseen levels use global fallback
configuration.rationale: V167 no-allocation segment deltaKS -.002942 vs +.004588 at1:3 observations; V178 zero-history remains -.000260. Partial pooling learns modest group bias from strictly inner-held-out correction predictions, not outer error-derived gates or separate small Kumo backbones. Sparse groups shrink to global correction.

configuration.label: Regularized worst-group regret V25 correction
configuration.formula: g=employment x allocation-present; merge correction groups n<200 to OTHER; Rg(beta)=mean_g[BCE(zK+Xbeta)-BCE(zK)]; minimize .05*log(mean_g exp(Rg/.05))+.003/2||beta[1:]||^2; pK=sigmoid(zK+.5*Xbeta); final=.75*pK+.25*spline77
configuration.rationale: KS gains differ by history coverage while pooled improvements remain small. Test a group-robust regret objective with existing90-coefficient V25 head, preserving dimensionality; distinct from prior global L2 and ranking-surrogate objectives. Group regret baseline avoids prioritizing high-entropy groups solely because of prevalence.

configuration.label: Joint local-context Kumo and29-input spectral correction
configuration.formula: Use exact cached V178 raw Kumo=.85*global+.15*local; refit29-input V167 correction with L2.003 and inference shrink.5; final=.75*sigmoid(logit(pK178)+.5*X29*beta)+.25*original_spline77
configuration.rationale: V185 combines final scores after independent heads; directly test whether spectral and context signals survive joint training. V185 public .56699 below V25 .56822 warns that an OOF-only gain is insufficient. Expect higher capacity risk; compare29-input head gap to V25.

configuration.label: Joint context/spectral correction with selective group shrinkage
configuration.formula: Same raw V178 Kumo and29 inputs asV191; meanBCE+.003/2*sum(base_beta^2)+.01/2*sum(spectral_beta^2), intercept unpenalized; inference shrink.5; original75:25 spline fusion
configuration.rationale: V167 head train-validation KS gap .016101 vsV25 .011108. Test joint information with stronger shrinkage specifically on all11 spectral inputs, including unstable dominant-cycle argmax; keeps input set matched to V191.

configuration.label: V185 plus bounded inner-OOF partial-pooling calibration residual
configuration.formula: z=logit(pV185); d=.5*clip(logit(pV189)-logit(pV25),-.1,.1); p=sigmoid(z+d); per-fold test fusion then mean5fold
configuration.rationale: V189 low-dimensional inner-OOF employment/history calibration yielded KS .530638, deltaAUC -0.0000041 vsV25; no generalization claim. Test bounded partial-pooling effect onV185; reject leaderboard recommendation if AUC or stability deteriorates. No fitted score weights.

configuration.label: Inner-crossfitted spectral/local evidence combination
configuration.formula: For each outer fold,3 inner splits of6k train base18/global, spectral29/global, local18/V178 heads on4k and predict held2k. Fit w_s,w_l in[0,1.5] by BCE(z_base+w_s*(z_s-z_base)+w_l*(z_l-z_base))+.02/2*((w_s-1)^2+(w_l-1)^2). Apply weights to full6k corrected-Kumo heads; final=.75*sigmoid(eta)+.25*original_spline77
configuration.rationale: V185 fixed logit fusion increases pooledKS but only3/5folds and mixed public outcome. Learn complementarity using strictly inner-OOF predictions, never using in-sample original spline or outer labels for mixing weights. Difference from V185 includes fusion before original spline and training-only weight fit.

configuration.label: Coverage safeguard for V185 spectral correction
configuration.formula: p=pV178 when aux_allocation_count<=0 or missing; otherwise pV185; per-fold test fusion then mean5fold
configuration.rationale: V185 no-allocation segment deltaKS -.003403 vsV25, while1:3 observations +.006123 and over3 +.000197; V178 no-allocation deltaKS -.000260. Fixed availability gate tests a mechanism suggested by prior outer errors; it is post-selection and not independent confirmation. Distinct from V172 fallback toV25 on a different spectral-context backbone.

configuration.rationale: V191 all11 spectral inputs raised head gap to.017657 and decreased AUC vsV185; phase argmax can be unstable under sparse orders. Test removal while preserving9 band-power/support features and identical context scores.

configuration.rationale: V192 stronger L2 on11 spectral features reduced KS and left head gap.016393. Test reducing basis complexity rather than shrinking all coefficients; removes one spline coefficient per numeric input.

configuration.label: Gaussian-rank preprocessing for V25 correction

configuration.rationale: Extreme historical financial measurements affect boundary knots and basis scaling. Train-reference ranks test robustness to outlier magnitudes without fitting on test distributions. Same18 inputs and frozen context.

configuration.label: P-spline-inspired coefficient roughness correction
configuration.formula: V25 head objective meanBCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.03/2||D2*(beta_spline/scale)||^2; difference penalty within each numeric spline block; shrink.5; original75:25 spline fusion
configuration.rationale: Global L2 does not distinguish smooth financial relationships from oscillating residual corrections. Add coefficient-difference regularization while keeping the18 inputs and90-coefficient design. Quantile knots differ from canonical equally spaced P-splines; do not claim an exact continuous curvature penalty.

configuration.label: Stabilized Jeffreys-information correction
configuration.formula: Minimize meanBCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2-.5/n*logdet(X^T*W(beta)*X/n+.0001I); original V25 design and shrink.5; original75:25 spline fusion
configuration.rationale: Sparse combinations of employment/missingness and repayment evidence can bias correction coefficients. Test a stabilized Firth-inspired information penalty; addedridge andL2 mean this is not exact classical Firth logistic regression. No transfer of published performance claims.

configuration.label: Laplace predictive uncertainty for original V25 head
configuration.formula: Fit original V25 beta; Sigma=(X^T*W*X+n*.003*diag(0,1,...)+1e-6I)^-1; eta=zK+.5Xbeta; v=.25*diag(X*Sigma*X^T); pK~=sigmoid(eta/sqrt(1+pi*v/8)); original75:25 spline fusion
configuration.rationale: V189 partial pooling gives a small gain without more input dimensions. Extend reliability to the head posterior: high-leverage applicants receive more predictive integration. Approximate Laplace uncertainty conditions on encoder/prior, excludes Kumo and model-selection uncertainty.

configuration.rationale: Test whether uncertainty is especially useful for the higher-dimensional spectral head rather than the compact original18. Same formula and conditional caveats asV202; compareV196 for the specific effect.

configuration.label: Frozen Small90 capacity control with exact V25 folds
configuration.formula: KumoSmall100%frozen, same90 inputs/50kcontext/seed2026+fold/8estimators; original18-input6k correction L2.003 shrink.5; same77-input spline and75:25fusion; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: All previous new inputs retained the same Large backbone and yielded small or unstable gains. Test a substantive reduction of pretrained capacity with identical data information, folds and adaptation settings. Earlier public Small results used different pipelines and are not transferred. Compare fresh LargeV168 as runtime control.

configuration.label: Frozen Small plus stable9 correction information
configuration.formula: ReuseV207 frozenSmall context predictions; fit27-input correction adding stable9 spectral inputs, L2.003/shrink.5; retain original75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: Separate capacity from representation by reusing identical Small scores and only adding9 stable power/support inputs. The Large analogV196 improves AUC without KS; Small may need complementary explicit temporal information, but benefit is unproved.

configuration.label: Conservative Small/Large capacity-diversity blend
configuration.formula: Perfold final=.90*pV193+.10*pV207, fixed weights before seeingSmall results; test probabilities averaged after per-fold blending
configuration.rationale: A smaller frozen expert can have different ranking errors despite lower standalone performance. Test limited complementary information, without fitting blend weights on outer labels; no public-score gain assumed.

configuration.label: V193 anchor with10% high-AUC reduced-knot representation
configuration.formula: Perfold p=.90*pV193+.10*pV198; fixed weights, then mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V198 AUC.84726014 exceedsV193 by.00015260 but its KS.52937399 is lower. Test a prespecified small contribution to broader ranking without replacing the stronger KS model. This is a new representation source, not an outer-fitted blend search.

configuration.label: Frozen Small original18 correction with reduced knots
configuration.formula: Same cachedSmall90/50kcontext asV207,18-input head with quadratic2knots ratherthan3, L2.003/shrink.5; same75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: Separate correction capacity from backbone capacity. Small may require a different residual complexity, but this remains a hypothesis. Context predictions and features are identical toV207.

configuration.label: Coverage-aware conservative Small/Large blend
configuration.formula: wSmall=.15*10/(max(finite_allocation_count,0)+10); p=(1-wSmall)*pV193+wSmall*pV207; missing count getsw.15; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V185 spectral contribution lost separation in no-allocation borrowers, while only one Large capacity was used. Test a bounded Small contribution larger for thin internal histories. Do not assume Small is safer: compare public-incumbent and development metrics, with explicit missing-data caveat.

configuration.label: V193 anchor plus10% low-gap P-spline expert
configuration.formula: Perfold p=.90*pV193+.10*pV200; fixed weights before own evaluation; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V200 AUC.84731949 exceedsV193 by.00021194 and its head gap.007482 is lower thanV25.011108, while KS.52956578 falls. Test a bounded contribution from a lower-variance correction, without selecting weights on outer labels; V200 deltaAUC CI vsV193 still crosses zero.

configuration.label: Smooth capacity effects while retaining sharp credit-risk responses
configuration.formula: V25 original18/globalKumo; BCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.03/2||D2*(beta_spline/scale)||^2 only on capacity inputs; other bases unchanged; shrink.5 and original75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: V200 smoothing all17 numeric responses improves AUC and reduces head gap but loses KS. It may over-smooth threshold-like delinquency/bureau effects. Apply the same penalty only to five income/cashflow/burden measurements; keep credit/history-response bases at original L2.

configuration.label: Smooth evidence reliability while retaining risk-level thresholds
configuration.formula: V25 original18/globalKumo; BCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.03/2||D2*(beta_spline/scale)||^2 only on evidence inputs; other bases unchanged; shrink.5 and original75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: Coverage counts and posterior SDs can create unstable residual bends, while burden/delinquency levels may need thresholds. Smooth only8 measurement-reliability/coverage effects; preserve financial-risk response flexibility. This tests a different mechanism from smoothing monetary capacity.

configuration.label: Smooth credit-level responses only
configuration.formula: V25 original18/globalKumo; add.03/2 D2 penalty only to bureau-score and late1/late30 posterior spline coefficients; other responses originalL2.003; shrink.5 and75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: V200 all-response smoothing improved AUC but reduced KS. ContrastV214 capacity andV215 evidence scopes by isolating the three credit-level responses. This diagnoses which domain drives the AUC/KS tradeoff, without assuming that residual risk is monotonic.

configuration.label: V193 anchor plus10% highest-AUC stable spectral smoother
configuration.formula: Perfold p=.90*pV193+.10*pV206; fixed weights; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V206 AUC.84740092 is highest among these correction candidates, but KS.52885147 loses separation at its best threshold. Test limited complementary risk ordering from the smoother rather than selecting a new blend weight on outer labels; compareV213 for a different information source.

configuration.label: Public-incumbent anchor with10% frozen Small
configuration.formula: Perfold p=.90*pV25+.10*pV207; fixed weights; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V209 anchors Small to development-bestV193, which inherits periodicity and selection risk. Test an otherwise identical capacity-diversity blend anchored directly to the public-incumbentV25, preserving a lower-complexity alternative. Small standalone lower AUC is a reason for caution, not assumed complementary benefit.

configuration.label: Bootstrap stability ensemble of reduced-knot local correction
configuration.head_gap_caveat: Bootstrap-ensemble apparent training score mixes in-bag and out-of-bag predictions; its train/validation gap is not directly comparable with single-head in-sample gaps. Judge held-out metrics and member variability.
configuration.formula: 3 class-stratified bootstrap draws of6k correction; each fitsV19827-input2-knot head on fixedrawV178; pK=mean3 corrected probabilities; final=.75*pK+.25*spline77; save variance of member logits
configuration.rationale: V210 adds a tiny KS/AUC gain from10%V198, while V198 alone improves AUC but loses KS. Test retraining sensitivity of that specific representation through three intentional resamples, rather than declaring an OOF-only improvement. V187 used4k delete-block bagging on a different18-input representation and was negative.

configuration.label: V193 anchor with10% resampled reduced-knot expert
configuration.formula: Perfold p=.9*pV193+.1*pV219; fixed weights; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Matched toV210, replacing only the singleV198 correction with its3-resample mean. Test whether the small simultaneous KS/AUC gain survives correction retraining variation; do not select the best member using held-out labels.

configuration.label: Uncertainty-gated V193 and bootstrap correction blend
configuration.head_gap_caveat: Fixed-score fusion has no new trained head; inherits source models and resampling-proxy limitations.
configuration.formula: m=median of3-member logit variance on correction-training only; w=.1*m/(m+query_variance); p=(1-w)*pV193+w*pV219; ifm undefined/nearzero retainV193 explicitly; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Test a bounded credibility gate that limits the lower-complexity representation where resampled corrections disagree. This is an epistemic proxy from3 conditional resamples, not a full posterior or a guarantee of safer risk estimates; no outer labels choose the gate.

configuration.label: Employment-conditioned frozen Large population context
configuration.formula: Group only original50k context by observedemployment; cap24k pergroup, keepnatural target proportions,8 frozenestimators; rawKumo=.85globalV168+.15matchinglocal, refit original18-input6k head and75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: The three employment populations differ in income regularity and affordability mechanisms. Observed labeled sizes33473/20987/15540 and targetrates.132405/.137943/.140283 motivate conditional relationships, not a causal employment claim. V178 grouped only history coverage; test a different population axis using unchanged90inputs.

configuration.label: Underwriting-regime frozen Large population context
configuration.formula: For each fold, compute medianAPR only within50k context; low/equal vs high groups, cap24k and8 frozenestimators; .85global+.15matchinglocal before original18-input correction and75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: APR is discretized: train/test quantiles include.16,.20,.24,.32 and median.20; no missing APR. Test whether local underwriting regimes help interpret bureau/burden signals. APR is policy-generated and could drift; no claim that it independently measures risk, and grouping never uses outer target.

configuration.label: Combined history/occupation population contexts before correction
configuration.formula: rawKumo=.5*rawV178+.5*rawV222=.85global+.075history-local+.075employment-local; refit18-input6k correction, .5shrink,75:25spline77fusion; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Occupation and history availability represent different borrower conditions. Test complementary context information before nonlinear correction with fixed weights and unchanged18 head inputs; avoid fitting dynamic weights on reused outer labels.

configuration.label: Coverage and underwriting population contexts
configuration.formula: rawKumo=.5rawV178+.5rawV223=.85global+.075coverage-local+.075APR-local; refit18-input correction and75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: History availability and underwriting regimes represent different mechanisms. Complete the paired population ablation with matched total15%local weight, unchanged data inputs, no optimized outer weights, and original6k correction.

configuration.label: Occupation and underwriting population contexts
configuration.formula: rawKumo=.5rawV222+.5rawV223=.85global+.075employment-local+.075APR-local; refit18-input correction and75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: Test complementarity of employment-conditioned affordability and policy-conditioned context without the coverage expert. This completes a controlled context-family ablation; shared context examples are not independent evidence.

configuration.label: Three population views with a fixed global anchor
configuration.formula: rawKumo=mean(rawV178,rawV222,rawV223)=.85global+.05each coverage/employment/APR local; refit18-input correction and75:25spline77fusion
configuration.rationale: Compare all three population views to each matched pair under the same total15%local budget. No additional correction features or outer-fitted weights; source overlap and repeated selection remain caveats.

configuration.label: Conservative global/coverage/employment raw fusion
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalV168,rawV178,rawV222)=.90global+.05coverage+.05employment; refit original18-input6k correction, L2.003/shrink.5; final75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V222 employment context KS.529872 and AUC.846984 did not improveV25; test stronger global anchoring for the same coverage/employment views instead of trusting local retrieval at15%.

configuration.label: Conservative global/coverage/underwriting raw fusion
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalV168,rawV178,rawV223)=.90global+.05coverage+.05APR; refit original18-input6k correction, L2.003/shrink.5; final75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Matched toV225 with total local influence reduced15% to10%; APR is policy-generated, so a stronger global anchor is a prespecified stability control, not an assumed gain.

configuration.label: Conservative global/employment/underwriting raw fusion
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalV168,rawV222,rawV223)=.90global+.05employment+.05APR; refit original18-input6k correction, L2.003/shrink.5; final75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Matched toV226 at a lower local budget; inspect whether conditional affordability/pricing information survives stronger shrinkage after employment-only context was negative.

configuration.label: Global anchor vote with all three population views
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalV168,rawV178,rawV222,rawV223)=.8875global+.0375each local view; refit original18-input6k correction, L2.003/shrink.5; final75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Complete the all-view ablation againstV227 by giving the global expert its own equal vote. Shared context borrowers are not independent evidence; fixed weights avoid an outer-validation weight search.

configuration.label: Frozen Small/Large raw fusion before correction
configuration.formula: raw=.50globalLargeV168+.50globalSmallV207; refit original18-input6k correction, L2.003/shrink.5; final75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V207 Small alone was weaker, whileV209 final-score blending gave a tiny numerical gain. Test combination before the18-input correction; changing fusion stage can expose complementary errors, but equal weights are not claimed optimal.

configuration.label: Half-strength history-population context
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalV168,rawV178)=.925global+.075coverage-local; refit18-input6k correction L2.003/shrink.5; same75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V178 was the strongest single population view among those tested. Isolate whether halving its15%local contribution improves stability before combining it with weaker views; fixed shrinkage and unchanged18-input correction.

configuration.label: Half-strength employment-population context
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalV168,rawV222)=.925global+.075employment-local; refit18-input6k correction L2.003/shrink.5; same75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V222 full15%employment context KS.529872/AUC.846984 was belowV25. This controlled single-view ablation tests weaker reliance; it is not assumed beneficial and is needed to interpret the multi-view combinations.

configuration.label: Half-strength underwriting-population context
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalV168,rawV223)=.925global+.075APR-local; refit18-input6k correction L2.003/shrink.5; same75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: V223 full15%APR context KS.530213/AUC.847032 was almost flat vsV25. Test half-strength policy-context influence, with references already fitted only on original50k context and no outer-fitted weights.

configuration.label: Global, history-population and Small raw capacity fusion
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalLargeV168,rawV178,globalSmallV207)=.6166667globalLarge+.05coverage-local+.3333333Small; refit18-input6k correction L2.003/shrink.5; same75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Small alone lost AUC, while weak final-score blending gave only small numerical gains. Change the fusion stage and retain a history-context view, using three equal votes before fitting the same correction. CompareV23250:50 raw capacity fusion; do not assume independent errors.

configuration.label: Five-view conservative raw context/capacity fusion
configuration.formula: raw=mean(globalLarge,coverageRaw,employmentRaw,APRRaw,globalSmall)=.71globalLarge+.03each local view+.20Small; refit18-input6k correction L2.003/shrink.5; same75:25spline77; mean5foldtest
configuration.rationale: Test all prepared contextual views with Small capped at an implicit20%equal-vote contribution before correction. Shared context examples and global components overlap, so this is fixed score fusion, not formal independent Bayesian evidence.

configuration.label: Natural cubic offset correction with linear tails
configuration.formula: Original18 V25 inputs, signedlog and training-median imputation; per numeric input restricted cubic basis with correction-training quantile knots(.05,.35,.65,.95), linear tails, standardized basis plus missing and employment indicators. Repeated knots use linear-only fallback. eta=logit(globalKumo)+.5Xbeta; fit meanBCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2 on6k; final=.75sigmoid(eta)+.25spline77, mean5foldtest.
configuration.rationale: Global coefficient roughness smoothing V200 increased AUC to.84731949 but reduced pooledKS to.52956578; stable9 reduced-knots V198 also traded KS for AUC. Test a different nonlinear boundary/shape restriction rather than further averaging weak population contexts. Linear tails can extrapolate badly and must be assessed; constant/repeated-knot coverage variables remain explicit.

configuration.label: Group-sparse selection of complete risk-feature effects
configuration.formula: Same original18 V25 spline design. Minimize meanBCE(offset+Xbeta)+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.001*sum_g sqrt(dim_g)||beta_g||_2. Each numeric spline block and its missing indicator is one group; employment dummies one group; intercept/logit not group-penalized. Convex proximal solver, KKT mapping checked. eta=offset+.5Xbeta; final75:25 original spline77; mean5foldtest.
configuration.rationale: V221's segment improvements are uneven and simple across-source mixtures V224-V234 fail against the development incumbent. Shared coverage, uncertainty and risk-level predictors may allow redundant weak correction effects. Remove entire feature effects within correction training rather than selecting individual coefficients by outer importance. Group sparsity is a hypothesis, not proof that any particular source is redundant.

configuration.label: Training-only principal-component compression of correction basis
configuration.formula: Fit original18 V25 spline encoder on6k; center its basis/missing/employment columns and retain PCA components explaining95%training variance, whiten=False. Preserve separate intercept and standardizedKumo logit. Fit meanBCE(offset+XPCA*beta)+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2. Inference eta=offset+.5XPCA*beta; final75:25spline77, mean5foldtest. No target used in PCA or component-count selection.
configuration.rationale: Reduced-knot and roughness controls improve some AUC measures but lose KS, suggesting the correction needs a different capacity constraint. Compress correlated basis directions instead of smoothing every input equally. Low-variance directions may contain important risk or thin-file information, so inspect those segments and reject if lost; PCA is not assigned semantic creditworthiness labels.

configuration.label: Feature-leverage weighted offset correction
configuration.formula: Original18 spline design. On6k only, b=encoded covariates excluding intercept/Kumo; S=cov(b)+.1I; d2=(b-mean)'inv(S)(b-mean); t=training95th percentile(d2); w=clip(sqrt(max(t,1e-12)/max(d2,1e-12)),.25,1). Fit sum w*BCE/sum w+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2. No query-time weight/gate. eta=Kumo logit+.5Xbeta; final75:25spline77, mean5foldtest.
configuration.rationale: Current best has weaker KS in zero-order(3428 rows), no-allocation(23732) and high-conditional-stress groups thanV25, while support-sensitive bootstrap corrections yielded only tiny gains. Test whether a small number of high-leverage feature combinations dominates correction coefficients. Weighting can suppress genuine high-risk or minority borrowers and change effective class balance; report weights/event rates and segment errors, no causal or robustness guarantee.

configuration.label: Brier proper-score correction with unchanged representation
configuration.formula: Same18-input V25 design and frozen globalKumo. Initialize beta with same-foldBCE head then minimize mean((sigmoid(KumoLogit+Xbeta)-y)^2)+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2 on6k. One fixed local optimization, no outer tuning. Inference eta=KumoLogit+.5Xbeta; final75:25spline77, mean5foldtest. Ridge scale held numerically fixed, not equal effective regularization across scoring losses.
configuration.rationale: Repeated experiments show KS/AUC tradeoffs and weak tail capture: V221 captures6 fewer defaults thanV25 in the top10% despite greater pooledKS. Test another proper scoring objective with unchanged data, without directly optimizing a selected KS threshold. Brier loss is nonconvex in logistic coefficients; stationary convergence does not establish a global optimum or better KS.
